name: Noti for WooCommerce
author: WPNoti

sections.description:
Run your WooCommerce store from your phone and never miss an important event.

Noti for WooCommerce connects your online store to the WPNoti mobile app. Get instant WooCommerce order notifications, monitor store activity, view orders and products, track visitors, and receive important business alerts wherever you are.

WPNoti gives store owners and managers a convenient WooCommerce mobile dashboard for iPhone and Android. Instead of repeatedly checking WordPress admin, you can follow sales and store activity directly from your phone.

WooCommerce mobile notifications

  • Receive push notifications for new WooCommerce orders.
  • See order totals, status, customer details, payment method, and purchased items.
  • Get alerts for store errors and checkout problems.
  • Receive security alerts when a new administrator or shop manager is added.
  • Get form submission notifications from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, and other supported forms.

Manage your WooCommerce store on mobile

  • Browse and search WooCommerce orders from the app.
  • View products and important store information.
  • Approve secure WooCommerce access to manage orders and products from your phone.
  • Connect multiple WooCommerce stores and keep their activity in one app.

WooCommerce analytics in your pocket

  • Monitor store visitors, unique visitors, and page views.
  • Follow sales and order activity while away from your computer.
  • Keep an eye on store health and plugin status.

Built for busy WooCommerce store owners

WPNoti is useful for merchants, shop managers, agencies, and anyone who needs fast WooCommerce order alerts and mobile store management. Setup takes only a few minutes:

  1. Install and activate Noti for WooCommerce.
  2. Open WooCommerce → Noti.
  3. Create a free WPNoti account or sign in.
  4. Pair your store with the WPNoti app.

Creating an account is free. Optional Pro features are billed by WPNoti outside WordPress.

Your store does not send data to WPNoti until a store manager chooses Connect under WooCommerce → Noti. Visitor tracking is disabled by default and can be enabled separately.

Stay informed with real-time store alerts

Important WooCommerce activity comes directly to your phone. WPNoti can notify you about new orders, form submissions, checkout problems, store errors, and new administrator or shop manager accounts. Open an alert to see the useful details and respond faster.

View and manage orders from anywhere

Check customer and order information without opening the WordPress dashboard on a computer. When you want mobile editing, WPNoti uses WooCommerce’s official authorization screen to request access. You remain in control and can revoke that access at any time under WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.

Until you approve editing, the app has read-only access. Disconnecting the store removes its WooCommerce API key from both your website and WPNoti.

Simple, privacy-conscious visitor analytics

Turn on visitor counting to see unique visitors and page views in the mobile app. This feature is optional and disabled by default.

WPNoti uses a first-party random visitor identifier for counting, not advertising. Visitor records remain on your store, logged-in editors are excluded, and supported consent plugins are respected. Developers can also control tracking with the noti_tracking_allowed filter.

Secure form notifications

Receive mobile alerts for Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, and other supported forms. WPNoti sends a short preview with the notification, while the complete submission is encrypted and stored on your own website.

Connect only when you are ready

Installing the plugin does not automatically connect your store or send store activity. Data sharing begins only after a store manager selects Connect under WooCommerce → Noti.

Privacy and external service disclosure

This plugin connects to WPNoti, a service operated by the plugin author, to provide the mobile app, push notifications, store monitoring, and connected-store features.

During connection, WPNoti receives the store URL, store name, currency, timezone, software versions, and a site token. Once connected, it may receive order summaries, short form previews, store and checkout errors, administrator or shop manager account alerts, and disconnection notices so these events can appear in the app.

The connected app can request orders, products, plugin health, stored form and error events, and visitor counts from the store. Editing orders and products requires separate approval through WooCommerce. The plugin does not provide access to change coupons, customers, users, or WordPress settings.

  • WPNoti terms of use
  • WPNoti privacy policy

Source code

The files included with this plugin are its source code. assets/beacon.js is the readable visitor-counting script; the plugin has no compile step.
sections.installation:
1. Install WooCommerce 8.0 or newer, then install Noti for WooCommerce from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate Noti for WooCommerce.
  3. Open WooCommerce → Noti and create an account, or sign in.
  4. Enter the pairing code in the WPNoti dashboard or app.
  5. Complete the “Approve store edits” step. WooCommerce asks you to allow the app to change orders and products.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work without an account?

You can install the plugin without an account, but connecting your store to the mobile app requires a free WPNoti account. Nothing is sent to WPNoti before you choose to connect.

Can I receive new order push notifications?

Yes. WPNoti sends a mobile push notification when a new WooCommerce order is created and lets you open the order details from the app.

Can I manage WooCommerce orders from my phone?

Yes. You can view WooCommerce orders in the app. Editing is enabled only after you approve access through WooCommerce’s official authorization screen.

Can I disconnect the app?

Yes. You can disconnect WPNoti and revoke its WooCommerce access at any time.

Where is visitor data stored?

Visitor records stay on your website. Counting is disabled by default and starts only after a shop manager enables “Count store visitors.” The app reads the resulting visitor totals when you open the visitors screen.

Where do form messages stay?

The complete form submission is encrypted and stored on your website. WPNoti receives only a short preview for the mobile notification and retrieves the full message when an authorized user opens that event.
